issue.title: REPRODUCE line for non-snapshot builds should link to the license

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
### Description

When a non-snapshot build fails, like https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/111612, it logs a reproduce line. Like so:
```
./gradlew ":x-pack:plugin:esql:test" --tests "org.elasticsearch.xpack.esql.CsvTests" \
  -Dtests.method="test {inlinestats.AggConstant}" -Dtests.seed=40A5CA1C44DAE3EE \
  -Dbuild.snapshot=false -Dtests.jvm.argline="-Dbuild.snapshot=false" -Dtests.locale=zh-HK \
  -Dtests.timezone=Asia/Ulan_Bator -Druntime.java=22
```

But that build won't run. You need to add an extra line like so:
```
```
./gradlew ":x-pack:plugin:esql:test" --tests "org.elasticsearch.xpack.esql.CsvTests" \
  -Dtests.method="test {inlinestats.AggConstant}" -Dtests.seed=40A5CA1C44DAE3EE \
  -Dbuild.snapshot=false -Dtests.jvm.argline="-Dbuild.snapshot=false" -Dtests.locale=zh-HK \
  -Dtests.timezone=Asia/Ulan_Bator -Druntime.java=22 \
  -Dlicense.key="x-pack/license-tools/src/test/resources/public.key"
```

This picks up the test license key. It's documented in the `TESTING.asciidoc` file, but it'd be lovely if the reproduce line came with it.
